---
title: "Helsinki city bikes usage"
format: 
  dashboard:
    theme:
      light: [litera, custom.scss]
      dark: [darkly, custom.scss]
    scrolling: true
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <link rel="icon" href="favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
        <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
        <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@400;500&family=Inter:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
        <style>
          .dataTables_wrapper,
          table.dataTable {
            font-size: 12px;
            font-family: Inter, sans-serif;
          }

          table.dataTable td,
          table.dataTable th {
            padding: 4px 8px;
          }

          .dataTables_info,
          .dataTables_paginate {
            font-size: 11px;
          }

          .quarto-dashboard .card:has(.dataTables_wrapper) > .card-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 0.75rem;
          }

          .year-filter-wrap {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 0.4rem;
            position: relative;
          }

          .year-filter-label {
            font-family: Inter, sans-serif;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 500;
            color: #1a1a1a;
            margin: 0;
          }

          .year-filter {
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 0.5rem;
            min-width: 4.5rem;
            font-family: Inter, sans-serif;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 400;
            color: #1a1a1a;
            background: #ffffff;
            border: 1px solid #ced4da;
            border-radius: 4px;
            padding: 0.2rem 0.5rem;
            cursor: pointer;
            user-select: none;
          }

          .year-filter:focus {
            outline: none;
            border-color: #ced4da;
          }

          .year-filter-caret {
            width: 9px;
            height: 9px;
            flex: none;
            color: #555555;
            transition: transform 0.15s ease;
          }

          .year-filter.open .year-filter-caret {
            transform: rotate(180deg);
          }

          .year-filter-menu {
            position: absolute;
            top: calc(100% + 4px);
            right: 0;
            min-width: 100%;
            background: #ffffff;
            border: 1px solid #ced4da;
            border-radius: 4px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
            list-style: none;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 4px 0;
            max-height: 220px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            z-index: 20;
            display: none;
          }

          .year-filter.open .year-filter-menu {
            display: block;
          }

          .year-filter-menu li {
            padding: 0.3rem 0.6rem;
            font-family: Inter, sans-serif;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 400;
            color: #1a1a1a;
            cursor: pointer;
            white-space: nowrap;
          }

          .year-filter-menu li:hover,
          .year-filter-menu li.active {
            background: #f2f2f2;
          }
        </style>
    nav-buttons:

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(DT)

data <- readRDS("hki-city-bike-usage-yearly.rds") |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) |>
  arrange(year)

stations <- readRDS("hki-city-bike-stations.rds") |>
  filter(station != "") |>
  mutate(year = as.numeric(year))

year_choices <- c("All", as.character(sort(unique(stations$year), decreasing = TRUE)))

# Build one aggregated station table per year (plus "All") for a given metric
aggregate_stations <- function(metric) {
  setNames(
    lapply(year_choices, function(yr) {
      d <- if (yr == "All") stations else stations |> filter(year == as.numeric(yr))
      d |>
        group_by(station) |>
        summarise(value = sum(.data[[metric]], na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
        arrange(desc(value))
    }),
    year_choices
  )
}

# Turn a named list of per-year data frames into a JSON object of row-arrays,
# ready to be dropped straight into DT via table.rows.add()
rows_json <- function(named_list_of_dfs) {
  rows <- lapply(named_list_of_dfs, function(df) {
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) unname(as.list(df[i, , drop = FALSE])))
  })
  jsonlite::toJSON(rows, auto_unbox = TRUE)
}

departures_by_year <- aggregate_stations("departures")
arrivals_by_year   <- aggregate_stations("arrivals")

departures_data <- departures_by_year[["All"]] |> rename(departures = value)
arrivals_data   <- arrivals_by_year[["All"]] |> rename(arrivals = value)

departures_json <- rows_json(departures_by_year)
arrivals_json   <- rows_json(arrivals_by_year)

# JS objects reorder integer-like keys (e.g. "2020") ahead of "All", so the
# dropdown order is built from this explicit array rather than Object.keys()
year_choices_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(year_choices)

title_font <- list(family = "Outfit, sans-serif", size = 13, color = "#1a1a1a")
accent_color <- "#FCBC19"
```

## Row {height="550px"}

### Column

```{r}
#| label: bike-journeys-by-year
plot_ly(data,
        x = ~year,
        y = ~count,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers",
        line = list(color = accent_color, width = 3, shape = "spline"),
        marker = list(color = "#ffffff", size = 10,
                      line = list(color = accent_color, width = 3)),
        hovertext = ~paste0(year, ": ", format(round(count, 1), nsmall = 1),
                             "M bike journeys"),
        hoverinfo = "text") |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "<b>City bike journeys by year</b>", font = title_font, x = 0),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    dragmode = FALSE,
    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = "#333333",
      bordercolor = "#333333",
      font = list(color = "#ffffff", family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12)
    ),
    xaxis = list(title = "",
                 tickvals = data$year,
                 tickformat = "d",
                 range = c(min(data$year) - 0.4, max(data$year) + 0.6),
                 showgrid = FALSE,
                 zeroline = FALSE,
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 11),
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = "Journeys (millions)",
                 titlefont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 12, color = "#1a1a1a"),
                 range = c(0, max(data$count) * 1.3),
                 dtick = 1,
                 tickformat = "d",
                 showgrid = FALSE,
                 showline = FALSE,
                 zeroline = FALSE,
                 tickfont = list(family = "Inter, sans-serif", size = 11),
                 fixedrange = TRUE),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    margin = list(t = 40, r = 30),
    annotations = lapply(1:nrow(data), function(i) {
      list(
        x = data$year[i],
        y = data$count[i],
        text = paste0("<b>", format(round(data$count[i], 1), nsmall = 1), "</b>M"),
        showarrow = FALSE,
        yanchor = "bottom",
        yshift = 10,
        font = list(color = "#1a1a1a", size = 12, family = "Inter, sans-serif")
      )
    })
  ) |>
  config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
```

## Row {height="500px"}

### Column

```{r}
#| label: top-departure-stations
#| title: "Most popular departure stations"
datatable(departures_data,
          colnames = c("Station" = "station", "Departures" = "departures"),
          rownames = FALSE,
          options = list(
            pageLength = 10,
            lengthChange = FALSE,
            dom = "tip",
            scrollY = "300px",
            scrollCollapse = TRUE,
            language = list(info = "_TOTAL_ entries")
          )) |>
  formatCurrency("Departures", currency = "", interval = 3, mark = " ", digits = 0) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender(paste0("
    function(el) {
      var yearData = ", departures_json, ";
      var years = ", year_choices_json, ";
      var table = $(el).find('table').DataTable();
      var card = el.closest('.card');
      var header = card ? card.querySelector('.card-header') : null;
      if (!header || header.querySelector('.year-filter-wrap')) return;

      var wrap = document.createElement('div');
      wrap.className = 'year-filter-wrap';

      var label = document.createElement('label');
      label.className = 'year-filter-label';
      label.textContent = 'Year';

      var control = document.createElement('div');
      control.className = 'year-filter';
      control.tabIndex = 0;
      control.setAttribute('role', 'button');
      control.setAttribute('aria-haspopup', 'listbox');
      control.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');

      var valueSpan = document.createElement('span');
      valueSpan.className = 'year-filter-value';
      valueSpan.textContent = years[0];

      var caret = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'svg');
      caret.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 10 6');
      caret.setAttribute('class', 'year-filter-caret');
      var path = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'path');
      path.setAttribute('d', 'M1 1l4 4 4-4');
      path.setAttribute('fill', 'none');
      path.setAttribute('stroke', 'currentColor');
      path.setAttribute('stroke-width', '1.5');
      path.setAttribute('stroke-linecap', 'round');
      path.setAttribute('stroke-linejoin', 'round');
      caret.appendChild(path);

      var menu = document.createElement('ul');
      menu.className = 'year-filter-menu';
      menu.setAttribute('role', 'listbox');

      function closeMenu() {
        control.classList.remove('open');
        control.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        document.removeEventListener('click', onDocClick);
      }
      function openMenu() {
        control.classList.add('open');
        control.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
        document.addEventListener('click', onDocClick);
      }
      function onDocClick(e) {
        if (!control.contains(e.target)) closeMenu();
      }

      years.forEach(function(yr, i) {
        var li = document.createElement('li');
        li.textContent = yr;
        li.setAttribute('role', 'option');
        if (i === 0) li.classList.add('active');
        li.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
          e.stopPropagation();
          valueSpan.textContent = yr;
          var items = menu.querySelectorAll('li');
          for (var j = 0; j < items.length; j++) items[j].classList.remove('active');
          li.classList.add('active');
          table.clear();
          table.rows.add(yearData[yr]);
          table.draw();
          closeMenu();
        });
        menu.appendChild(li);
      });

      control.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (control.classList.contains('open')) closeMenu(); else openMenu();
      });
      control.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          e.preventDefault();
          if (control.classList.contains('open')) closeMenu(); else openMenu();
        } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
          closeMenu();
        }
      });

      control.appendChild(valueSpan);
      control.appendChild(caret);
      control.appendChild(menu);

      wrap.appendChild(label);
      wrap.appendChild(control);
      header.appendChild(wrap);
    }
  "))
```
